title: Allow to always force facet refinement

comments.body:
Hello,

Great question. We also need this behaviour. @vvo does the lib can support this out of the box ? Or it needs some new feature ?

Thanks for answer :)

There is not easy way to do that in the current version. You can define default filters like you did, but they will still be removed with a `clearAll` and be displayed in the related refinement list.

This is an issue that pops up regularly (we have a longer discussion about it here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/740). Let me know if this is the same issue you're referring to so we can put all discussion on the same topic.

Long story short, we totally agree that this is needed, but we couldn't yet find a public API that would be satisfying. With more real-world example I'm sure we'll find something.
One way to solve this is to pass a list of parameters to not clear to the clearAll widget

#addToFAQ

Closing in favor of #1063. clearAll/currentRefinedValues should support not clearing some attributes.
